فقط متن ساده‌ی IP و رنج‌اند و فقط به‌عنو: These are plain text lists of IPs and ranges, read only as data (no file is run or opened). Any line that is not a valid IP or CIDR is skipped, internal and reserved ranges are never counted as malicious, and the saved file is checked against its fingerprint. No IP from your network is sent out, and there is no limit on how many IPs you check. They are downloaded again like the feed above (at most every “download again” minutes).
